title: N-AALP Multicodec Registry (signer-id keys and multihash)
description: Schema for the JSON representation of vectors/registry/multicodec.csv: an array of row objects, one per referenced multicodec code (the signer-id public-key codecs and the multihash used in content-id). code is the multicodec code point as a hex-prefixed unsigned varint of variable width (e.g. 0x12, 0xed, 0x1211). N-AALP references the multiformats registry and does not fork it. Format/required/enum defects (wrong-format code, missing column, out-of-set role or status, empty reference) are caught here; DUPLICATE codes are caught by the companion scripts/validate_registries.py.

name.description: Multicodec name; MUST be non-empty (e.g. ed25519-pub).

code.description: Multicodec code point, hex-prefixed unsigned varint, at least 2 hex digits (e.g. 0x12, 0x1211).

role.description: How the code is used in N-AALP: a multihash hash function (content-id) or a signer-id public-key multicodec.

status.description: multiformats registry status of the code.
